Kento Alpha 0.5, build 959

In this build

  • Undo history: Undo and Redo name the step they undo ("Undo Set Grade1.white"), and Edit > History... lists every step of the comp by name. Click any step to go back or forward to it in one move. Two settings, both off (Settings > General > Undo history): keep the history in the comp, so a reopened comp can go back to its earlier steps, and a step selects the nodes it changed.
  • Settings and Quit stay available in the Kento menu after a comp opens.
  • The Window menu lists your open comps; choose one to bring it forward.
  • The Edit menu's AutoFill, Dictation and Emoji items now sit at its end, after Kento's own.
  • Brighter nodes and wires if you want them: Settings > Node Graph > Visibility has node brightness, node saturation, wire brightness, wire thickness and glyph size (the flow chevrons, ports and input labels), with quick presets (As designed, Brighter, Brightest, Bold wires).
  • A Timeline mark's text is one Note box.
  • Grade and ColorCorrect's mix luminance works, matching Nuke.
  • RotoPaint's global motion blur draws as Roto's does.
  • The PDF manual's part pages: their chapter lists no longer run over the titles.

Not yet

  • The History window to its new design (board 38).
  • EdgeExtend's detail amount and Inpaint2's smoothness above 2 are close, not exact.
  • ZDefocus and SplineWarp in comps: kept, not rendered yet.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; Roto open splines.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 952

In this build

  • ChromaKeyer keys as Nuke does: chroma gain, screen gain, the balance on red, green and blue screens, the alpha and despill biases, the black and white points and the replace modes, all checked pixel for pixel.
  • New nodes, checked against Nuke: EdgeExtend, Inpaint2, GenerateLUT (writes .cube, .3dl, .csp and .vf) and OCIONamedTransform. TimeDissolve follows its curve.
  • Comps open closer to how they look in Nuke: the classic Shuffle writes its second layer (alpha into depth and the like), MinColor uses the offset its analysis stored (Analyze on its panel), Dilate takes a separate width and height, and about a thousand more knob expressions now work, DasGrain's among them.

Not yet

  • EdgeExtend's detail amount and Inpaint2's smoothness above 2 are close, not exact.
  • Grade and ColorCorrect's mix luminance.
  • ZDefocus and SplineWarp in comps: kept, not rendered yet.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; Roto open splines.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 931

In this build

  • ChromaKeyer: the green and blue screen keyer, checked against Nuke, in comps and as a new node.
  • Fixed: the menus went from the menu bar, all but Kento, when a comp was opened over the empty window.
  • Fixed: a new Grade, ColorCorrect or GodRays failed to be made, and new nodes with an output channel started on Undistort, from another node's starting value.

Not yet

  • ChromaKeyer's chroma gain and its black and white points.
  • ZDefocus, EdgeExtend, SplineWarp and Inpaint in comps: kept, not rendered yet.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; a clone source from another frame.
  • Roto open splines.
